analysis: The PR changes only docs/architecture/inference.md: a date bump at line 3 and a rewritten `stop` row at line 2122 (stop-sequence scope handling for Gemma 4 and `<think>` parsers, plus the native block engine). No executable code, keys, attestation, encryption, or trust-boundary logic is changed. I examined the two supplied head-text units, which are surrounding documentation covering cluster KV precision, SSD prefix record encoding, GPT-OSS/MiMo batch behavior, and Qwen media. Those sections are unchanged context, not new behavior in this diff. Relevant threat entries are T-041 (SSD prefix cache) and TB-007, but the docs describe existing behavior and the diff doesn't alter that posture. The stop-scope row is a description of provider-side output matching and does not affect the consumer-prompt confidentiality boundary (A-001). The change reads as a documentation accuracy fix. One open question: whether the underlying code change that this doc describes (ReasoningStopScope, EngineV2Bridge+StopSequence.swift) exists elsewhere in the PR. It was not supplied here, so its behavior is unverified and a later pass should confirm that stop-string matching scope cannot cause leakage of reasoning text. No threat-model gap is introduced by this documentation change.
